title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. translated_title: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化动力学链推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作领域已取得显著进展，但其泛化能力仍受限于带有动作标注的机器人示范数据的多样性与覆盖范围。人类视频提供了更广泛的行为与环境经验，然而从中学习面临可扩展数据与显式动作落地之间的根本性权衡。我们提出ThinkWorld，这是一个将动作推理扎根于世界动力学、并通过带有世界想象的强化学习加以增强的VLA学习框架。ThinkWorld将每个动作思考表示为动力学链，即一系列离散的运动token，它捕捉连接当前世界与未来状态的中间动力学过程，并作为跨具身形态的通用动作表示。我们首先使用带动作标注的示范数据对CoD进行初始化，然后预测每个CoD所引致的未来状态，并强化那些……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ThinkWorld框架，以动力学链作为跨具身通用动作表示，将动作推理与世界动力学相结合，并借助世界想象的强化学习增强VLA模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: ThinkWorld represents action reasoning as Chain-of-Dynamics, a common cross-embodiment action representation, and reinforces it through reinforcement learning with world imagination to improve VLA generalization.
